fichas.title: Computer Workstations
fichas.summary: Guidance for planning computer workstations around the specific work procedure, with ergonomic posture, reachable work areas, adjustable furniture, adequate legroom, and environmental recommendations. The page also describes workplace standards and psychosocial principles for workstation design.
